methodology.summary: From 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z (slop-value-v1), Slopbot's source-bound value assessments size each accepted pull request and value its reviews; a valid maintainer ratification is the exception that takes precedence. An accepted merge without a current assessment, or assessed at zero, keeps the 10-point minimum. Each pull request's review pool is the sum of the highest assessed bands of its first 5 distinct qualifying reviewers, capped at the pull request's assessed size and never less than 10 Points; it is split by band in 10-point increments by largest remainder. Each unreversed debit from Slopbot's published penalty table reduces its author's Points for the same project and UTC month once, never below zero; an upheld appeal or a maintainer reopen removes it, and closed reward cycles keep their recorded Points. Work accepted earlier keeps its earlier v2 and SCR-05 rules unchanged. Payout approval remains separate.

scoringRules.points: micro 10; small 30; medium 90; large 240; XL 450; exceptional 750
scoringRules.cap: uncapped; related or split pull requests share one workUnitId
scoringRules.qualification: From 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z (slop-value-v1), a complete exact-head assessment or valid human ratification binds the accepted outcome. Divide its unchanged implementation Points by each primary author's accepted additions plus deletions, on every base branch, using whole-Point largest remainder. Opening or merging the PR alone earns no share. Overlapping accepted commits require joint work-unit assessment. New unassessed merges retain the 10-Point minimum; missing multi-author allocation evidence holds existing Points. Earlier unassessed PR totals are preserved when their recipients are corrected.

scoringRules.points: included in the ratified outcome tier
scoringRules.qualification: Resolution value is evidence for the work-unit tier, not a second score.

scoringRules.points: included in the ratified outcome tier
scoringRules.qualification: Test depth informs complexity and value but is not farmable additive credit.

scoringRules.points: included in the ratified outcome tier
scoringRules.qualification: For the author's newest 5 deep-inspected merged pull requests per project and UTC month, contributor-authored proof is bound to the merged head via a single evidence-head marker, appears in a stable evidence row in the canonical PR body, uses an immutable GitHub attachment URL, and passes bounded remote byte and structure verification. Author post-merge body edits still void the package; a non-author post-merge body edit keeps the package only while the evidence-head still matches the merged OID. Mutable release assets, comment copies, inline text, N/A rows, unreachable artifacts, and third-party claims do not qualify.

scoringRules.points: triage 10; standard 30; deep reproduction 90; specialist 240; ratification 10
scoringRules.cap: one pool per pull request: the credited reviewers' bands, capped at the pull request's assessed size, minimum 10 Points; at most 5 distinct reviewers; one credited record per reviewer
scoringRules.qualification: From 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z (slop-value-v1), complete source-bound assessments value distinct evidenced review outcomes, including useful validation; a request for changes is not required. Reviews by implementation actors, bots, after merge or closure, and duplicate findings do not qualify. Each pull request's allocation window has the scoring window's length and ends at its merge or closure, so every run selects the same reviewers and divides the same pool. A qualifying review submitted before that window publishes review-credit-outside-window and takes no reviewer slot or share. A credited review inside it but before the current scoring window keeps its slot and share, publishes review-credit-outside-window and keeps its earlier Points. The remaining reviews are grouped by immutable reviewer ID and ordered by their first qualifying review's submission time in the allocation window, then review node ID. The first 5 share the pull request's review pool by their highest assessed band in that window using integer largest remainder, earlier reviewers first on equal remainders. Later reviewers publish review-credit-reviewer-limit. Valid human decisions and reviewed evaluation awards take precedence. Missing, stale or unresolved assessments do not receive legacy review credit. Reviews of pull requests accepted earlier keep the SCR-05 rule.

scoringRules.cap: uncapped; cannot duplicate an ordinary source or work unit
scoringRules.qualification: A public, strictly validated award manifest was reviewed and merged into elizaOS/slopdotcash for useful implementation, tests, review, diagnosis, or evidence that is not already rewarded as a merged outcome.

materialTestThreshold.cap: 4 points for each of the newest 5 qualifying merged pull requests per contributor

exclusions: GitHub Bot actors and bot-pattern logins
reviews of bot-authored or unattributed pull requests
self-reviews
reviews submitted after merge

pull-request comments created or edited after merge; bodies created after merge; author post-merge body edits; and non-author post-merge body edits that no longer pin the merged head via a single evidence-head marker
duplicate immutable GitHub node IDs
repeated reviews by the same reviewer on the same pull request
from 2026-10-01, approvals, requests for changes the merge ignored, and every review after the one review award on a pull request
arbitrary external media links, bare checksums, and unstructured evidence claims
unreachable, empty, malformed, wrong-kind, or conflicting evidence artifacts
closed issues that only carry GitHub's COMPLETED state reason
issue reports whose author did not also author the linked merged fix
score-bearing evidence supplied only by a third party
unreviewed evaluator output or evaluator output that duplicates an already-scored source
nonScoringActivity: commit count within the 35-day verification window
methodology.provenancePolicy: Leaderboard model identifiers come only from text sources causally attached to a scored contribution by the same actor. Exact provider/model declarations, human-only declarations, and contribution-attribution markers remain self-reported provenance; complete, partial, missing, and invalid states add no points.
methodology.collectionPolicy: The same complete collection pipeline runs for every repository in the published project registry; records merge by immutable GitHub node ID and every artifact keeps its repository attribution. A scalar-only, budget-preflighted census selects every merged pull request with formal reviews for complete review hydration; missing or inconsistent census/detail data aborts the snapshot instead of publishing partial review credit. Score v2 applies to work from 2026-08-01 UTC. Every accepted merge receives at least provisional micro credit, and provisional small credit when merged from 2026-10-01. Any other tier requires an unedited maintainer-authored slop-score record bound to the PR node ID and exact head SHA; corrections append a successor. Proposal review records disclose exact provider, model, client, run, trace, effort, complexity, impact, review load, split risk, and confidence. XL and exceptional decisions require a second maintainer. Project reward views exclude work before the published reward start.

Accepted outcome awaits a current Slopbot value assessment; it keeps the one-third minimum until assessed.
